title: Migration Notes
lede: Upgrading from 1.x? Here's what carries over and what changes.
body:
At a glance
  • Live state moves toward a database.
  • Folder layout is tidied.
  • Your projects and voices carry over.

State: toward SQLite

Durable data lives in SQLite, with live runtime state in state.json. Existing data is migrated forward. See State: state.json + SQLite.

Folders & compatibility

Storage is normalized into clear per-project folders. Compatibility shims keep older layouts working during the transition.

What carries over

Your projects, chapters, and voices come with you. The workflow is unchanged; the machinery underneath is what moved.

In progress — exact migration steps are finalized as 2.0 lands; this page will get the concrete checklist.
